question: Should OpenClaw core permanently own the top-level `auth` CLI root even though plugins are documented as owning root command groups?
rationale: Removing the collision removes the PR's central feature, while accepting it changes the extension namespace contract for existing and future plugins; that ownership decision cannot be resolved mechanically.

options.title: Keep the plugin root available
options.body: Retain `models auth list` as canonical and improve discovery without registering a core `auth` root.

options.title: Reserve `auth` for core
options.body: Approve core ownership only with an explicit collision policy, affected-plugin audit, compatibility behavior, documentation, and fresh-install/upgrade proof.

recommendation.title: Keep the plugin root available
recommendation.body: Retain `models auth list` as canonical and improve discovery without registering a core `auth` root.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history most strongly connects this person to plugin CLI registration and registry ownership.
